# Element Fire Extinguishers

> > Element Fire Extinguishers manufactures compact, potassium-based molecular fire suppression systems for automotive, professional, and home use.

Element's flagship products—the E50 and E100—use innovative potassium nitrate (KNO3) chemistry to suppress fires through molecular interruption rather than traditional smothering methods. The company serves automotive enthusiasts, professional racing, RV owners, and home safety markets with environmentally-friendly, no-thrust discharge technology.

## Key Topics

- Element E50
- Element E100
- Potassium-based fire suppression
